label: King Charles poised to strike the Commonwealth like a scorpion
description: The British monarch seen poised to strike Australia, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland and France, turning his body like a scorpion. An allegation about a named living head of state with no act specified, sitting alongside the scorpion tail claim about persecution in the same countries.
aliases: turning his body like a scorpion

label: An iron curtain over Canada and freedoms stripped
description: Something like an iron curtain seen coming over Canada with all freedoms being stripped away, the spirit behind it named as the antichrist spirit, and Holy Ghost fire coming as Canadians rise up. Given alongside whiskey barrels rolling down and an economy in trouble facing great trying times.

label: An extension running from Russia to Cuba
description: Given 7 October 2025 as the escalation that concerns him most because it is close to home: an extension seen running from Russia to Cuba.

label: Missiles launched from submarines in the escalation
description: Missiles seen coming out of submarines and fired from the ocean, given alongside the red-tipped missiles going into Moscow. The launch platform is the checkable detail.
